clauses.clause: Breach 2 at +20–30 s from ≥ 2 accesses, ≥ 10 infected (tune); power off within 1 frame, red emergency light; abandon at breach 2 + 15 s or ≥ 3 bitten.
clauses.note: Both tiers: second breach21.0167s after first, ten actual same-ID bodies from accesses0/1 reach shelter floor; main power off and red emergency group active on actual breach tick3253 and next tick. Abandon4147 is14.9s later with three bitten/lost roster members, satisfying the explicit alternative. Independent80s ordinary controls retain identical world hashes. Physical frames show main-light fall and red emergency fixtures; unfinished browser routes are not promoted to completion.
